question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'** i.e.** 'Used'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 1 is:** 'Used'.**
 
• In this context, **"used"** is the best choice.
 
• The **sentence** reads: "In Switzerland these glacial meltwaters are used for hydropower."
 
• **This means **that the glacial meltwaters are utilized or exploited for generating hydropower.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is:* 'In Switzerland these glacial meltwaters are **used **for hydropower. In fact, water falling on 93% of Switzerland ultimately passes (2) __________ at least one electric power plant before even (3) __________ the country. So one consequence is that melting glaciers help to (4) __________ for low rainfall in times of drought, filling reservoirs to supply the nation's (5) __________ supply.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here's why the other options are not the correct answer:
 
 
• **'Chosen'** - This would imply that the glacial meltwaters are selected for hydropower, which isn't exactly correct because the glacial meltwaters aren't being selected among alternatives. They are being utilized directly.
 
• **'Plotted'** - This would imply that there is some kind of scheme or plan involving the glacial meltwaters. It doesn't make sense in this context.
 
• **'Glued'** - This is completely irrelevant in this context. 'Glued' implies adhering or sticking things together, which doesn't fit the sentence about utilizing meltwater for hydropower.
